fact_text: Searle's flagship products include Hydralin cough syrup, a paediatric oral rehydration product, Metodine, and the Newball painkiller range, alongside vitamin water and other FMCG lines.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pharmaceuticals are the majority of Searle's revenue, with nutrition, medical devices and FMCG making up the rest.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Many active pharmaceutical ingredients are oil derivatives, so raw-material costs for painkillers and similar drugs move with oil prices.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Packaging and distribution salaries are important cost lines for pharma companies, alongside raw materials such as paracetamol-based inputs.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In 2024 the government deregulated non-essential medicines, so companies can set their own prices for those products.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Essential medicines whose production cost outran their regulated price can get a one-time price revision through a hardship-case process approved at prime-minister level.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A small price rise combined with a small cost cut can multiply profit: a Rs100 drug costing Rs90 earns Rs10, but at Rs110 price and Rs80 cost it earns Rs30, about three times more.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Biologic medicines are hard to copy generically, because copying them needs a biotech plant, whereas API-based drugs attract generic versions more quickly.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Local biologics replace imported medicines, cutting cost to patients and giving the maker better margins, and local production also helps with temperature-controlled storage.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The biopharma plant is set up through a collaboration with a Chinese partner, and the analyst notes Chinese production technology is generally cost-competitive.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A locally made GLP-1 diabetes medicine priced well could be a large opportunity for Searle, given high diabetes prevalence in Pakistan and wide use of oral medication and insulin.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Searle plans to launch denosumab injections, which are mainly used for bone weakness and cancer-related bone conditions, as part of its new biopharma range.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's FY26 estimates put Searle revenue at roughly PKR 32-35 billion, gross profit near PKR 17-18 billion and operating profit around PKR 5-5.5 billion.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The same FY26 estimate gives after-tax profit of roughly PKR 3-3.5 billion, equal to about PKR 6-6.5 of earnings per share, after lower finance costs from debt repayment.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Selling a subsidiary reduced Searle's heavy debt, which lowers finance costs and lets after-tax profit rise as the debt is gradually repaid.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The FY26 estimates exclude profit from the new biopharma products, which the analyst would add once the company announces launch prices and expected market share.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's rule of thumb is that listed local pharma companies usually trade at around 15 times earnings, which is a common multiple used to frame their valuation.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Budget 2025 was positive for pharma: under the IMF-linked trade liberalisation, import duties on pharma inputs were cut by about 2-3 percentage points on average, lowering production cost.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In FY21 Searle acquired the OBS products, mainly Vinofer and Decaron, to localise them and cut cost, but the localisation plan did not succeed and cheaper generic versions arrived.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Funding the acquisition with heavy bank borrowing, when policy rates reached around 22%, pushed finance costs above the acquired business's earnings and into loss.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Searle sold the acquired product lines in FY25 for well below what it had paid, with financing costs on top, which the analyst treats as the main cause of the earlier decline.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Minority shareholders suffered heavy losses from the failed acquisition and FY22-FY23 bear market together, showing how one poor capital allocation decision can compound a market downturn.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A stable rupee limits currency devaluation losses for equity investors during a bull market, so share gains are more fully kept in rupee terms.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Searle Pakistan's top local listed Pharma Company, Everything You Need to know about the Turnaround!' (YouTube transcript, undated)
